extracted.intended_audience: UK mathematics olympiad contestants, team leaders, coaches, and organisers (and others interested in the Romanian Master of Mathematics / UK participation)
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of the Romanian Master of Mathematics (RMM) competition format, UK team selection practice, team-scoring method, and links to past papers and leader reports. Useful for prospective UK contestants, team leaders, and coaches preparing for or reviewing RMM participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team ranking method
rubrics_metrics.description: Official team rankings are based on the scores of the top three contestants from each team only.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From 2018 the team rankings use the top three scores out of four contestants who are nominated in advance for the team competition. Only those top-three scores contribute to the official team result.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team size / number of contestants sent
rubrics_metrics.description: The UK sends six contestants to this competition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The UK does not always name a reserve. Team composition for individual participation is six students; team-competition nomination rules (e.g., four nominated) affect which subset count for team rankings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection timing
rubrics_metrics.description: UK participants are selected in January.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection timing is 'subject to the timing of this competition' (i.e., actual selection date may vary depending on the year's event schedule).

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition format — number of papers and questions
rubrics_metrics.description: There are two papers, each consisting of three questions, mirroring the IMO format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The format varied at the first two competitions; otherwise it follows the two-paper, three-problem-per-paper structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scoring per problem
rubrics_metrics.description: Each question is marked out of 7 points.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied total per paper is up to 21 points and total contest score up to 42 points (two papers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of past papers and team leader reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-by-year listing of dates, papers, and team leader's reports (with links to original, clarified, HTML or PDF versions) for RMM editions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides direct links to papers and leader reports for multiple years (2008–2026, with some years cancelled or non-participation). Use these linked resources for preparations and reviewing past problems and reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation exceptions / notable years
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain years have special notes: 2014 event cancelled; 2021 UK did not participate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such exceptions affect whether the UK sent a team or whether papers/records exist for that year; check the year-specific entry for details.
